clinical_note: Orthopedic Surgery Follow-up. 38-year-old female with right knee pain for 3 years, worsening over the last 12 months. Pain 8/10, limits walking to under 1 block, difficulty with stairs; wakes at night from pain. Conservative care: 12 weeks of supervised physical therapy (Jan-Apr 2026) without lasting benefit; naproxen 500 mg BID for 6 months, stopped due to GI upset; two intra-articular corticosteroid injections (Feb 2026, Jun 2026) with less than 4 weeks of relief each; hyaluronic acid series Aug 2026 with no improvement. Exam: varus deformity, effusion, medial joint line tenderness, ROM 5-95 degrees, antalgic gait. Weight-bearing X-ray right knee (Sep 2026): Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4, bone-on-bone medial compartment, osteophytes, subchondral sclerosis. BMI 29. No active infection. Assessment: severe primary osteoarthritis right knee (M17.11) refractory to conservative management. Plan: right total knee arthroplasty (CPT 27447). Patient counseled and consents.
